high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "finforall." The post features a graphic with a simple illustration of a person wearing a suit and tie, standing next to a large upward-pointing arrow. The background is a gradient of orange shades. The text accompanying the graphic reads: "These new sectors range from the defence sector, where Tata Advanced Systems is eyeing a bigger role, to manufacturing hardware for telecom companies (think Huawei) through its acquisition of a 43.3 percent stake in Tejas Networks."
